name: How do I prepare my home for a tile floor replacement project?

mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my home for a tile floor replacement project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your tile floor replacement begins, we recommend clearing the designated area of all furniture, appliances, and personal belongings. Remove any wall hangings or fragile items that could be affected by dust or vibrations. Ensure pets and children are kept away from the work zone for safety. Our team will cover adjacent surfaces and ensure proper ventilation, but taking these preliminary steps helps streamline the process, protect your valuables, and allows our installers to work efficiently and safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by clearing furniture and personal items from the work area, removing wall hangings, and ensuring pets and children are away. This streamlines the project and protects belongings.
